blocker_status.actionability_rationale: There is no validated mapping: s_tire -> specific tire pressure / compound / carcass configuration. Phase 3O may still produce MODEL_PARAMETER_DECISION_SUPPORTED, but a resulting parameter value must not be presented as an immediately installable physical track setup.

exploratory_preliminary_estimate.label: EXPLORATORY_FIT_ESTIMATE
exploratory_preliminary_estimate.qualification: Discovered during initial unsealed reconnaissance loss sweep on Turn 1. Not a pre-registered candidate.

formal_generation_protocol.tie_breaking_rule: Choose candidate value closest to nominal reference 1.000

data_partitions.authoritative_definition: The sample-index sets are the authoritative partition definition. Time intervals are half-open and are derived from the authoritative sample indices.

fit_temporal_buffer.description: 5 ms inter-partition boundary buffer separating Fit and Temporal holdouts.

temporal_cross_buffer.description: 1.0 s straightaway transfer buffer separating Temporal and Cross holdouts.

cross_maneuver_holdout_partition.description: Independent sustained high-G carousel (ay >= 1.0 G, peak 1.14 G, yaw rate 0.504 rad/s, 27% throttle, zero braking).

fit_partition.description: High transient corner entry and sustained apex; peak ay = 0.88 G, peak yaw rate = 0.354 rad/s.

temporal_holdout_partition.description: Corner exit unwinding (steering unwind 7.7 deg to 0 deg, throttle application to 50%); verifies unwinding stability.

dataset_provenance.authors: Daiki Mori, Rohit K. Aggarwal, Nicholas D. Broadbent, Tatsuya Kobayashi, J. Christian Gerdes
dataset_provenance.title: Vehicle Dynamics Dataset for Highly Dynamic Automated Driving

confounding_audit.collinearity_reason: In quasi-steady cornering, tire lateral force capacity is modulated by both contact-patch cornering stiffness (pKy1) and effective camber inclination (gamma) via Pacejka camber thrust and lateral curvature terms.

cross_maneuver_generalization.bootstrap_target: Delta_RMSE^(b) = RMSE_candidate^(b) - RMSE_baseline^(b) on Turn 2 Carousel
cross_maneuver_generalization.decision_rule: CI_upper < 0.0 (95% bootstrap CI on Delta_RMSE strictly excludes zero in improvement direction)
cross_maneuver_generalization.evaluation_scope: SETUP-P3O-CAL vs SETUP-P3O-BASE on Turn 2 Carousel ONLY

dynamic_jounce.admissibility_limit: Peak dynamic jounce <= 55.0 mm (clearance buffer >= 5.0 mm to bump stop)

sideslip_angle.nature_of_constraint: Engineering stability boundary, not a statistical confidence threshold
sideslip_angle.provenance: slipAngle_rad = arctan2(Vy_mps, Vx_mps) derived from integrated GNSS/INS state vector

bootstrap_configuration.replicate_formula: RMSE_m^(b) = sqrt(mean_{i in b}((r_m,i - r_meas,i)^2)), Delta_RMSE^(b) = RMSE_cand^(b) - RMSE_base^(b)

temporal_non_inferiority.policy: Only bootstrap-derived confidence intervals on Delta_RMSE are permitted. Zero heuristic confidence intervals are permitted.

superseded_reasons: Clarified bootstrap target to per-replicate Delta_RMSE rather than MSE difference
Designated sample indices as authoritative and time intervals as half-open
Completed formal sideslip gate with REJECT_DUE_TO_SIDESLIP_STABILITY_BOUNDARY status
Explicitly bifurcated execution blockers (NONE) from physical actionability (BLOCKED / NOT_YET_MAPPED)

target_mechanism.actionability_demarcation_note: s_tire is a fully functional simulation model parameter in DynamicLapSimulator. However, no validated physical transfer function connecting s_tire to cold inflation pressure, tire compound, or carcass durometer exists in the repository. It is NOT asserted as an immediately track-installable hardware setting.
target_mechanism.baseline_qualification: Generic manufacturer default for passenger performance tires in Pacejka MF 5.2. Not a track-measured tire card.
production_equation_path: Ky = pKy1 * Fz0 * sin(2 * arctan(Fz / (pKy2 * Fz0))) * (1 - pKy3 * |gamma|) * lambda_k
Fy0 = Dy * sin(Cy * arctan(By * alpha_y - Ey * (By * alpha_y - arctan(By * alpha_y)))) + Svy

target_vehicle: 2017 Volkswagen Golf VII GTI Performance (FWD, MQB Chassis)
track_venue: Thunderhill Raceway Park — West Track (Willows, CA)
